@@U02466@@
He has no idea what’s about to descend. Soon there'll be no room for his foolish antics. Law is a powerful weapon, but necessity more so.

@@U02468@@
We, the Wild Men, shout and yell, Sweeping from mountain height and dell, We come, and stop us no one can, We celebrate the mighty Pan. We know what none else know, and fling Ourselves into the vacant ring.

@@U02470@@
I know you well, and I know your great god Pan. This is a bold plan you've entered into. I also know what not everyone knows, and so I dutifully open this circle’s narrow boundary.

@@U02471@@
(Aside.)

@@U02472@@
I pray a fortuitous fate attend them! Wondrous things are possible, but little do they know where their steps lead them. They're unprepared for what might happen.

@@U02474@@
All decked out, you gawk and stare! But here we come, rough and rare, Leaping, bounding, a frenzied pace, A sturdy and a vigorous race.

@@U02476@@
We fauns come dancing a jolly dance, oak leaves crowning our curly hair,

@@U02464@@
并看着这一切发生！我的员工在哪里？我把他赶出去！

@@U02466@@
他不知道接下来会发生什么。很快，他的愚蠢行为就没有立足之地了。法律是强大的武器，但更重要的是必要性。

@@U02468@@
我们，野人，大喊大叫，从高山和山谷中横扫而来，我们来了，没有人能阻止我们，我们庆祝强大的潘。我们知道别人不知道的事情，然后将自己投入到空荡荡的环中。

@@U02470@@
我很了解你，也了解你的潘大神。这是你制定的一个大胆的计划。我也知道一些不为人知的事情，所以我尽职尽责地打开了这个圈子的狭窄边界。

@@U02471@@
（旁边。）

@@U02472@@
我祈祷幸运的命运眷顾他们！奇妙的事情是可能发生的，但他们几乎不知道自己的脚步将他们引向何方。他们对可能发生的事情毫无准备。

@@U02474@@
一切都打扮好了，你目瞪口呆！但我们来了，粗暴而罕见， 跳跃，跳跃，疯狂的步伐， 一场强健而充满活力的比赛。

@@U02476@@
